subject: Solace Health MAP: hosting mode & regional commitment — alignment

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, procurement@solacehealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Solace MAP kickoff — hosting mode, region constraints, and timeline

Marissa / Karthik — thanks again for last week's demo. We promised a consolidated MAP and a shortlist of questions from our security and infra teams so we can pick between hosted / dedicated / private for our initial rollout.

Attached is a short internal doc with our priorities (latency in west-coast regions, HIPAA gating items). High-level asks:
- Can Redwood support a staged path (hosted → dedicated reserved pool → private on-prem) with minimal migration effort?
- If we choose Dedicated, what lead times and capacity commits are typical?
- For Private, what does the on-prem packaging look like and who manages the control plane?

We'd like a working MAP that ties milestones to decision points and a signing deadline for procurement. Can you circulate a mapped plan by EOD Monday?

[Attachment: Solace_Requirements_v1.docx (doc)]

— Elena
Director of Product
Solace Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@solacehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@solacehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Solace MAP kickoff — hosting mode, region constraints, and timeline

Elena — thanks for the clear priorities. I put together a draft MAP and a short comparative summary for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. See the spreadsheet attached (Solace_MAP_v2.xlsx). Key highlights up front:

- Staged path is supported and is our recommended approach: start hosted to accelerate time-to-first-integration, then move to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable throughput, and finally Private only if regulatory or data residency forces it.
- Typical lead times: Hosted = instant (API), Dedicated = 4–8 weeks for capacity provisioning + legal, Private on-prem = 8–12+ weeks depending on network and KMS integration.
- Migration effort: we keep the same API surface and model versions; main work is data egress controls, VPC peering, and HSM/KMS setup for Private.

Requested next steps in the MAP (proposed milestones):
1) Week 0–1: Confirm evaluation PoC scope and latency targets.
2) Week 2–4: PoC runs against hosted in us-west for latency baseline; synthetic load.
3) Week 5–6: If baselined, spin up Dedicated dev pool (1–2 GPU nodes) for throughput and cost tests.
4) Week 7–10: Security review + procurement terms; Private sizing only if required.
5) Week 11: Executive decision & signoff.

Please review timeline on the sheet and flag any constraints. If you want, we can add a canary rollback policy and an acceptance checklist per milestone.

[Attachment: Solace_MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

— Marissa
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@solacehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Ravi Sinha <ravi.sinha@solacehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 13:50:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Solace MAP kickoff — hosting mode, region constraints, and timeline

Adding a few technical clarifications from infra:

- Dedicated SLA: we can offer a 99.9% availability SLA for reserved pools with multi-tenant fallback to hosted in the same region as an emergency escape hatch.
- Autoscaling/burst: Dedicated supports burst to hosted capacity for short windows; that will affect billing and needs a clear escalation path.
- Private on-prem: control plane is customer-managed in the VPC option; Redwood provides a minimal operator bundle and remote observability connectors (audit logs streaming to your SIEM). Network testing window is required.

Also attaching a short checklist we'll use during PoC (configuration, PKI/KMS notes). If Solace plans to evaluate in us-west only, we can pre-stage nodes to shorten the 4–8 week window to ~3 weeks for Dedicated.

— Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference

Elena — quick commercial points to align with the MAP:

- If you commit to a 12‑month Dedicated reservation, we can tier the discount (5–15%) based on committed GPU-hours.
- Procurement ask: we need a single point of contact for T&Cs redlines and a signature milestone in the MAP (we've listed Week 11).

I'll put this into the HubSpot deal (HUB-78912) and share a quick pricing sketch by Monday. If you want to discuss procurement timing, loop in your legal.
